blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Naga City Mayor and now 3rd District Rep. Nelson Legacion on Friday, Nov. 27, welcomed the filing of a complaint before the Office of the Ombudsman to probe the stalled Naga City Convention Center. Legacion told the Inquirer that the land in Brgy. Carolina where the project is situated is owned by the Naga City government per deed of donation. “Its private character ceased and it is now public, owned by LGU Naga, including the improvements thereon, such as the Phase 1 of the proposed Convention Center,” he said in a message.
